sn46.13:1.1: suriyassa bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ yadidaṃ aruṇaggaṃ.
sn46.13:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ uppādāya etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ yadidaṃ yonisomanasikāro.
sn46.13:1.3: yonisomanasikārasampannassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati, satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarissatīti.
sn46.13:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaroti?
sn46.13:2.3: upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.13:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti, satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarotīti.
